SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrMath > 400
  AND sc.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0
  AND s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3

SELECT CDSCode
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT f.`School Name`,
       s.Street,
       s.City,
       s.State,
       s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30

SELECT sat.sname AS school,
       sch.CharterNum,
       sat.AvgScrWrite,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sat.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools sch ON sat.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sat.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sch.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN satscores AS sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
  AND sat.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT T1.`School Name`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE CAST(T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND T2.NumGE1500 >= 1500

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       sat.AvgScrWrite AS avg_writing_score,
       s.Phone AS communication_number
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', s.OpenDate) AS INTEGER) > 1991
   OR CAST(strftime('%Y', s.ClosedDate) AS INTEGER) < 2000

WITH diffs AS (
    SELECT s.School AS school_name,
           s.DOCType AS doc_type,
           (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS diff
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT school_name, doc_type
FROM diffs
WHERE diff > (SELECT AVG(diff) FROM diffs)

SELECT s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE sat.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
  AND sat.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(sat.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / sat.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
  AND sat.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School, AVG(sat.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_writing_score
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich'
GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.School

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT s.School,
           s.County,
           ss.AvgScrRead,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rn
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores ss ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
      AND ss.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / 12 AS monthly_avg_schools_opened_1980
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = '52'
  AND OpenDate LIKE '1980%'

SELECT s.School,
       f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '31'
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` = (
      SELECT MAX(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)`)
      FROM schools s2
      JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.DOC = '31'
  )

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '54' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Orange' AND StatusType = 'Merged'

SELECT `School Name`,
       `FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND `Low Grade` = 'K'
  AND `High Grade` = '9'

SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools
WHERE County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
  AND Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY school_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.Charter = 0
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT name FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.rarity = 'mythic'

  AND l.format = 'gladiator'

JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'

SELECT l.status
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.types = 'Artifact'
  AND c.side IS NULL
  AND l.format = 'vintage'

SELECT c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
FROM cards AS c
JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
GROUP BY c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
ORDER BY COUNT(r.id) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power = '*'

SELECT s.City,
       COUNT(*) AS school_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_provision_count
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND f.`Low Grade` = 'K'
  AND f.`High Grade` = '8'

FROM foreign_data

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid)
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
  AND c.borderColor = 'white'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS unknown_power_triggered_ability_count
FROM cards
WHERE (power IS NULL OR power = '*')

SELECT T2.type
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
WHERE T2.language = 'German'

SELECT st.language
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.baseSetSize = 180

SELECT id,

             / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE isStorySpotlight = 1) AS percentage
FROM cards
WHERE isStorySpotlight = 1 AND isTextless = 0

SELECT language
FROM foreign_data
WHERE multiverseid = 149934
SELECT language FROM foreign_data WHERE name = 'A Pedra Fellwar'

FROM set_translations AS st
JOIN sets AS s ON st.setCode = s.code

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM legalities AS l
JOIN cards AS c ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE LOWER(l.format) = 'commander' AND LOWER(l.status) = 'legal'

FROM cards

FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code

FROM sets s

  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations st
    WHERE st.setCode = s.code

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND c.convertedManaCost > 5

SELECT fd.flavorText
FROM foreign_data AS fd
JOIN cards AS c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'

SELECT fd.name
FROM foreign_data fd
JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.setCode = (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Coldsnap')

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND c.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON c.setCode = s.code

SELECT c.name, l.format
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.edhrecRank = 1

SELECT DISTINCT s.name
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations k ON k.setCode = s.code
WHERE k.language = 'Korean'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM set_translations j
      WHERE j.setCode = s.code
        AND j.language LIKE '%Japanese%'

SELECT DISTINCT c.name, l.format
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON c.setCode = s.code
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Hour of Devastation'

WHERE CreationDate >= '2011-01-01' AND CreationDate < '2012-01-01'

SELECT p.Body

SELECT u.DisplayName

SELECT p.FavoriteCount

FROM posts p

WHERE p.Score > 5

SELECT COUNT(p.Id) AS PostCount

SELECT u.DisplayName

FROM comments c

SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE Score = 17

SELECT u.DisplayName

SELECT u.DisplayName

FROM votes v

SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)

FROM users u
WHERE u.Id IN (
    SELECT p.OwnerUserId
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL

SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN postHistory ph ON ph.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Views >= 1000
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
HAVING COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT ph.PostId)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio_2010_to_2011
FROM votes

SELECT u.DisplayName, SUM(p.ViewCount) AS TotalViews
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName IN ('Harvey Motulsky', 'Noah Snyder')
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
ORDER BY TotalViews DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0
       / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Community'

        JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
        WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mornington')

        FROM posts p

SELECT MIN(v.CreationDate) AS FirstVoteDate
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'chl'

SELECT COUNT(pl.Id) * 1.0 / 12 AS avg_monthly_links_2010
FROM postLinks pl
JOIN posts p ON pl.PostId = p.Id
WHERE strftime('%Y', pl.CreationDate) = '2010'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE b.Name = 'Autobiographer'
ORDER BY b.Date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.Id, p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky'
ORDER BY p.ViewCount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM (
    SELECT u.Id
    FROM users u
    JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.Location = 'United Kingdom'
    GROUP BY u.Id
    HAVING SUM(p.FavoriteCount) >= 4
) AS uk_users

SELECT DISTINCT t.TagName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
JOIN tags t ON instr(p.Tags, '<' || t.TagName || '>') > 0
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes'
  AND p.CommentCount = 0

SELECT p.Id AS PostId,
       COALESCE(u.DisplayName, p.OwnerDisplayName) AS OwnerDisplayName
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2010'
ORDER BY p.FavoriteCount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2011' AND u.Reputation > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id

SELECT DISTINCT u.Reputation, u.UpVotes
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON u.Id = c.UserId
WHERE c.Text = 'fine, you win :)'

SELECT p.ViewCount, u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN postHistory ph ON ph.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON u.Id = ph.UserId
WHERE ph.Text = 'Computer Game Datasets'
ORDER BY ph.CreationDate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_score_comments
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.CommentCount = 1
  AND c.Score = 0

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN u.UpVotes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM customers

WITH banned_counts AS (
    SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS banned_count
    FROM legalities
    WHERE status = 'Banned'
    GROUP BY format
),
top_format AS (
    SELECT format
    FROM banned_counts
    ORDER BY banned_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT l.format, c.name
FROM legalities l
JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
  AND l.format = (SELECT format FROM top_format)

SELECT y.CustomerID
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
GROUP BY y.CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT substr(y.Date, 5, 2) AS month,
       SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
GROUP BY y.Date
ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID = 6
  AND Date BETWEEN '201308' AND '201311'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS more_sme_czk_than_eur
FROM customers
WHERE Segment = 'SME'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM yearmonth
WHERE Date = '201202'

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment, (c2013 - c2012) * 100.0 / c2013 AS pct
    FROM seg
)
SELECT Segment, pct
FROM (SELECT Segment, pct FROM pct ORDER BY pct DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT Segment, pct
FROM (SELECT Segment, pct FROM pct ORDER BY pct ASC LIMIT 1)

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM "transactions_1k" AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN products AS p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date) = '2013-06'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS customer_count
FROM customers AS c
JOIN yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'

SELECT COUNT(t.TransactionID)
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'
  AND t.Date > '2012-01-01'

SELECT DISTINCT c.Currency
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Time = '16:25:00'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cze_transactions
FROM "transactions_1k" AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'
  AND t.Date = '2012-08-26'
  AND t.Time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00'

SELECT c.Segment
FROM "transactions_1k" AS t
INNER JOIN customers AS c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-23' AND t.Time = '21:20:00'

SELECT g.Country
FROM "transactions_1k" AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24'
  AND t.Price = 548.4

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS PremiumPercentage
FROM gasstations
WHERE Country = 'SVK'

SELECT t.CustomerID,
       SUM(t.Price) AS TotalSpent,
       SUM(t.Price) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Amount) AS AvgPricePerItem,
       c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN customers AS c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Team AS T ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND M.season = '2009/2010'
  AND M.away_team_goal > M.home_team_goal
GROUP BY M.away_team_api_id, T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END))
     / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID = (
        SELECT CustomerID
        FROM "transactions_1k"
        WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Price = 634.8
        LIMIT 1
      )
  AND substr(Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')

SELECT buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes
ORDER BY buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4

SELECT L.name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
  AND M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal
GROUP BY L.id, L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
  ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY AVG(pa.heading_accuracy) DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT L.name
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY L.id, L.name
HAVING AVG(M.home_team_goal) > AVG(M.away_team_goal)

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.birthday) AS INTEGER)
       - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', p.birthday)) AS age
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
  ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97
  AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) BETWEEN '2013' AND '2015'

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE substr(birthday, 1, 7) = '1970-10'

SELECT pa.overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas'
  AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) = '2011'

SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS avg_home_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Poland' AND m.season = '2010/2011'

SELECT (
    SELECT AVG(pa.ball_control)
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo'
) - (
    SELECT AVG(pa.ball_control)
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye'
) AS ball_control_difference

SELECT SUM(t2.overall_rating) * 1.0 / COUNT(t2.id) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player AS t1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2
    ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', t2.date) BETWEEN '2010' AND '2015'
  AND t1.height > 170

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_players
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND attacking_work_rate = 'low'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
  AND SUBSTR(m.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04'

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
  ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.volleys > 70
  AND pa.dribbling > 70

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
  ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) < '1986'
  AND pa.defensive_work_rate = 'high'

SELECT L.name
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY L.id, L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Pietro Marino'

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND pa.date LIKE '2015-05-01%'

SELECT ta.defenceAggressionClass
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'
  AND ta.date LIKE '2015-09-10%'

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
  AND SUBSTR(pa.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

SELECT pa.date
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
ORDER BY pa.crossing DESC, pa.date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
ORDER BY pa.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_short_name
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE ta.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM Player
WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'
  AND birthday > '1990'

SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN pa.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' THEN pa.overall_rating ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN pa.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Landon Donovan', 'Jordan Bowery')
  AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%'

SELECT DISTINCT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS ta
JOIN Team AS t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player)

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
ORDER BY pa.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM Match)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.Id) AS HighScorePercentage
FROM posts p
WHERE p.OwnerUserId = (
    SELECT u.Id
    FROM users u
    ORDER BY u.Reputation DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND LOWER(d.A3) = 'east bohemia'

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id)
FROM client c
INNER JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.height < 180 AND pa.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(pa.id) AS percentage
FROM Player AS p
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS district_count
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000

SELECT d.A2
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29'

SELECT a.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.date LIKE '1997%'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MIN(l2.amount)
      FROM loan l2
      JOIN account a2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id
      WHERE l2.date LIKE '1997%'
        AND a2.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  )

SELECT a.account_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND d.A11 = (
      SELECT MAX(d2.A11)
      FROM client c2
      JOIN district d2 ON d2.district_id = c2.district_id
      WHERE c2.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  )

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage
FROM loan

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.client_id) AS male_percentage
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS district_region
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage
FROM loan
WHERE amount < 100000

SELECT DISTINCT
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS state,
    (d.A13 - d.A12) * 100.0 / d.A12 AS unemployment_increment_pct
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(c.client_id) AS female_count
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY female_count DESC
LIMIT 9

WITH first_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
b1 AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM first_loan)
      AND t.date <= '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
b2 AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM first_loan)
      AND t.date <= '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (b2.balance - b1.balance) * 100.0 / b1.balance AS increase_rate
FROM b1, b2

SELECT COUNT(*) AS approved_loan_count
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_client_count
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  )

SELECT d.type
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district t ON a.district_id = t.district_id
WHERE d.type <> 'OWNER'
GROUP BY d.type
HAVING AVG(t.A11) > 8000 AND AVG(t.A11) <= 9000

SELECT t.*
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 3356
  AND t.operation = 'VYBER'

SELECT AVG(d.A15) AS avg_crimes_1995
FROM district d
WHERE d.A15 > 4000
  AND d.district_id IN (
      SELECT a.district_id
      FROM account a
      WHERE a.date >= '1997-01-01'
  )

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'
  AND t.amount < (
      SELECT AVG(t2.amount)
      FROM trans t2
      WHERE t2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
        AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) = '1998'
  )

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS women_percentage
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND di.A11 > 10000

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
      / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan AS l
JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND strftime('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997')

SELECT a.frequency, t.k_symbol
FROM account AS a
LEFT JOIN trans AS t
    ON t.account_id = a.account_id
   AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
   AND t.amount = 3539
WHERE a.account_id = 3

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS male_weekly_statement_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT cl.client_id, cl.gender
    FROM client cl
    JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
) c

SELECT c.client_id,
       CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM card AS cd
JOIN disp AS d ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT d.surname
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 19
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
ORDER BY q.q2 ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT r.name
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.country = 'Germany'

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 20 AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY q.q1 DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT DISTINCT c.lat, c.lng
FROM circuits c
JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'

SELECT DISTINCT c.lat, c.lng
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE r.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'
SELECT number FROM qualifying WHERE raceId = 903 AND q3 LIKE '1:54%'

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.dob
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.raceId = 592
  AND r.time IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.dob ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS not_finished_drivers
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix'
  AND ra.year = 2007
  AND r.time IS NULL

SELECT c.url
FROM constructorResults cr
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
WHERE cr.raceId = 9
ORDER BY cr.points DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.nationality
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.code
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 45
  AND q.q3 LIKE '1:33%'

SELECT name
FROM races
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', date) = (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(date)) FROM races)

SELECT (CAST(r1.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) - CAST(r2.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) * 100.0
       / CAST(r1.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) AS percent
FROM results r1
JOIN drivers d ON r1.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN results r2 ON r2.driverId = r1.driverId AND r2.raceId = 854
WHERE d.forename = 'Paul'
  AND d.surname = 'di Resta'
  AND r1.raceId = 853

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.name AS race_name, lt.milliseconds
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = lt.raceId
WHERE lt.milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(milliseconds) FROM lapTimes)
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.points
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
ORDER BY r.points DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, c.location
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE r.date >= '2005-09-01' AND r.date < '2005-10-01'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.position > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(r.raceId) AS percentage
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND ra.year >= 2010
SELECT lat, lng FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Silverstone Circuit'

SELECT r.name AS race_name,
       r.year,
       r.date,
       res.points
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY r.year ASC, r.round ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH winners AS (
    SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM results
    WHERE positionOrder = 1
    GROUP BY driverId
    ORDER BY wins DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.forename,
       d.surname,
       d.nationality,
       w.wins,
       (SELECT MAX(ds.points) FROM driverStandings ds WHERE ds.driverId = w.driverId) AS max_points
FROM winners w
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = w.driverId

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'Germany' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE r.name = 'European Grand Prix'
SELECT circuitRef FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'

SELECT nationality
FROM drivers
WHERE dob IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY dob ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT r.positionOrder
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND ra.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND ra.year = 2008

SELECT MAX(CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) AS fastest_lap_speed
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
  AND ra.year = 2009

SELECT r.name, r.year
FROM results res
INNER JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
INNER JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY res.rank ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.driverId) AS finished_driver_count
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.year = 2008
  AND ra.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND r.time IS NOT NULL

SELECT r.time
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.year = 2008
  AND ra.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND r.position = 2

SELECT COUNT(*) AS circuit_count
FROM circuits
WHERE location = 'Adelaide' AND country = 'Australia'

SELECT c.name
FROM constructorResults cr
JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE cr.raceId = 291
  AND cr.points = 0

SELECT MAX(cs.points) AS max_points
FROM constructorStandings AS cs
INNER JOIN constructors AS c ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE c.nationality = 'British'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT cr.constructorId
    FROM constructorResults cr
    JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
    WHERE c.nationality = 'Japanese'
      AND cr.points = 0
    GROUP BY cr.constructorId
    HAVING COUNT(cr.raceId) = 2
) AS japanese_zero_point_constructors

WITH race AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2008 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
champ AS (
    SELECT milliseconds AS ms
    FROM results
    WHERE raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM race) AND positionOrder = 1
),
last_finisher AS (
    SELECT milliseconds AS ms
    FROM results
    WHERE raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM race) AND time IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY positionOrder DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (last_finisher.ms - champ.ms) * 100.0 / last_finisher.ms AS percentage_faster
FROM champ, last_finisher
SELECT code FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'American'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId)
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes l ON d.driverId = l.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'French'
  AND l.milliseconds < 120000

SELECT COUNT(*) AS disqualified_finishers
FROM results
WHERE raceId > 50
  AND raceId < 100
  AND statusId = 2
  AND time IS NOT NULL

WITH last_race AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2009
    ORDER BY round DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
champ AS (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM driverStandings
    WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM last_race)
      AND position = 1
)
SELECT r.fastestLap
FROM results r
WHERE r.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM last_race)
  AND r.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM champ)

SELECT c.location,
       c.lat,
       c.lng,
       COUNT(r.raceId) AS times_held
FROM circuits c
JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.country = 'Austria'
GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.location, c.lat, c.lng

SELECT c.constructorRef, c.url
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN constructors c ON r.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE ra.year = 2009
  AND ra.name = 'Singapore Grand Prix'
  AND r.positionOrder = 1

WITH last_race AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(round) AS maxround
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
champs AS (
    SELECT r.year, ds.driverId
    FROM driverStandings ds
    JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
    JOIN last_race lr ON lr.year = r.year AND lr.maxround = r.round
    WHERE ds.position = 1
)
SELECT r.year,
       AVG(res.milliseconds / 1000.0) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
JOIN champs c ON c.year = r.year AND c.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.year < 1975
  AND res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year

WITH youngest AS (
    SELECT d.driverId
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN qualifying q ON q.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE d.dob IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY d.dob DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT r.year, r.name, r.date, r.time
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE q.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM youngest)
ORDER BY r.date ASC, r.time ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.major_name
FROM major AS T1
INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major
WHERE T2.first_name = 'Angela' AND T2.last_name = 'Sanders'

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND r.year = 2008
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY q.q3 ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name,
       d.nationality,
       r.name AS first_race
FROM drivers d
JOIN results res ON res.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE d.dob = (SELECT MAX(dob) FROM drivers)
ORDER BY r.date, r.round, r.raceId
LIMIT 1

SELECT i.amount
FROM income AS i
JOIN member AS m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.position = 'Vice President'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id)
FROM attendance a
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
  AND m.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE LOWER(e.type) <> 'fundraiser'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 20

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS fullName
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
